lines.text: Many learners say: He said me the truth.
Better: He told me the truth.
Tell takes the person; say does not.
Told! She told me a story.

data.why: Tell takes the person; say does not.

native.tip: По-русски «сказал мне», отсюда “said me.” Но say не берёт человека без to: “told me” или “said to me.”
native.caption: Ты тоже говоришь “He said me the truth”? 😅 По-русски «сказал мне» тянет за собой “said me”, а нужно “told me.” Правильно: “He told me the truth.” Послушай Карлоса и повтори! Больше практики — в приложении Lexkite.
native.comment: Ответ: “told.” С человеком — told. Бесплатный тест для практики здесь: {link}

en.tip: In Russian, “told me,” hence “said me.” But say does not take a person without to: “told me” or “said to me.”
en.caption: Do you also say “He said me the truth”? 😅 With “me”, you need “told me.” Correct: “He told me the truth.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
